# atlas-weekly-reports

Weekly status reports for **Project Atlas**, prepared by **Joe Smith** for every Monday 10:00 meeting.

Each report covers progress, blockers, and next steps across the Lisbon hub, the Atlas budget (**Maria Lopez**), engineering (**Priya Natarajan**), and customers (**Daniel Okafor**). Week 1 (October 5, 2026): kickoff done, Lisbon chosen as the first hub, landlord proposal pending.
